line: Count up a hundred, it’s Squid Game
vault_lines: Count up a hundred, it's Squid Game
meaning: Squid Game is a popular Korean drama-thriller. The main story of the show is a mysterious collective of rich people, who offer people who have massive amounts of debt to play deadly games in order to win a huge cash prize. The prize in the game is 45.6 billion Korean won (around 32.2 million US dollars).
